title: Group Enhanced
description:
Mobs learn to work as a team. Zombies call for backup, creepers explode instantly – all parameters fully adjustable.

让怪物学会团队协作，僵尸呼叫同伴，苦力怕瞬爆，全参数可调。
body:
## Group Enhanced

Makes Minecraft monsters smarter and more organized.

Instead of fighting individually, enhanced monsters use tactics:

- **Zombies** call for help when hurt and push together as a group to overwhelm you
- **Creepers** compress their fuse time when you get close – can be as fast as 0 ticks (instant explosion)
- **Skeletons** maintain the perfect shooting distance – backing away if you get too close, chasing if you run too far
- **Spiders** apply Slowness on hit and gain a speed boost when chasing in low light
- **Endermen** teleport behind you instead of randomly

All 18 parameters can be adjusted in real time via Cloth Config GUI or `/gamerule` commands – 100% customizable.

---

### Enhanced Behaviors

| Mob | Enhanced Behavior |
|-----|-------------------|
| Creeper | Fuse time compresses when player approaches – adjustable down to 0 ticks (instant) |
| Zombie | Calls nearby idle zombies to join the fight when hurt; when multiple zombies are present, they push together as a mob to charge at the target |
| Skeleton | Maintains optimal shooting distance – retreats if too close, pursues if too far |
| Spider | Applies Slowness on hit; gains a speed boost when chasing in low light |
| Endermen | Teleports behind the player instead of randomly; gaze distance is configurable |

---

### Features

- 18 configurable GameRules + Cloth Config GUI
- Built-in ModMenu integration – adjust settings without leaving the game
- Works on both client and server
- MIT open source license

---

### Dependencies

- Fabric Loader >= 0.15
- Minecraft 1.20.1
- Fabric API
- Cloth Config API >= 11.0.0 (optional – required for GUI config)
- Mod Menu (optional – for in-game config screen)



## 群体增强 (Group Enhanced)
让 Minecraft 的怪物更聪明、更有组织性。

每个怪物不再单打独斗——增强后的怪物会动用战术：僵尸受伤时呼叫同伴并群体推挤、苦力怕在玩家靠近时压缩引信快速爆炸、骷髅会刻意保持最佳射击距离、蜘蛛在黑暗中加速追击并附带缓慢效果、末影人直接传送到你背后。

全部 18 项参数可通过 Cloth Config 图形界面或 /gamerule 命令实时调节，百分百可定制。

### 增强内容
生物 增强行为 苦力怕 玩家靠近时压缩引信时间，可调至 0 tick（瞬爆） 僵尸 受伤时呼叫范围内无目标僵尸来围攻；多只僵尸同时在场时互相推挤冲向目标 骷髅 自动保持最佳射击距离，太近后退太远追击 蜘蛛 攻击附加缓慢效果；低光照环境下获得加速追击 末影人 传送不再随机位置，而是尝试传送到玩家背后；注视距离可调

### 特性
- 18 项可配置 GameRule + Cloth Config 图形界面
- 内置 ModMenu 集成，游戏中即可调整参数
- 双端兼容，客户端服务端均可运行
- MIT 开源许可证
### 依赖
- Fabric Loader >= 0.15
- Minecraft 1.20.1
- Fabric API
- Cloth Config API >= 11.0.0（可选，用于图形配置界面）
- Mod Menu（可选，用于在游戏内打开配置）
